protocol.scope: offline saved-artifact replay; validation-tuned developmental results
protocol.inputs: 120 training and 40 validation videos from frozen cache_drift_v2; no test data parsed or evaluated
protocol.training: all 0<=r<t<16 pairs; 120 pairs/video; 14,400 rows from 120 source videos
protocol.standardization: training-only population mean/std; std<=1e-12 uses scale 1
protocol.target: existing float64 1-clipped cosine(f_t,f_r), pre-decision; safe norm >1e-12
protocol.motion_interval: decoded frames strictly after most recent actual refresh through current frame; reset on refresh
protocol.missing_motion: zero magnitude plus explicit availability, never an exclusion

score.simple_motion: current candidate p90 magnitude in codec-displacement pixels
score.regression: raw recorded; clip predicted drift to [0,2] for all decisions

protocol.threshold_grid: training-pair score quantiles at 0,5,...,100%, linear; remove duplicate values; add always and wait
protocol.threshold_rule: refresh iff clipped score >= numeric threshold, unless exact budget rule overrides
protocol.threshold_selection: minimize equal-weight mean validation-video output error; ties within 1e-12 take earliest grid order: always, ascending unique thresholds, wait
protocol.global_threshold: one per scored policy and budget, not per video/class; models fit once, never changed by validation
protocol.budget_rule: mandatory refresh 0; reuse if remaining=0; refresh if remaining equals remaining candidate positions including current; otherwise policy rule
protocol.random_seed_derivation: integer from first 16 SHA256 hex digits of adaptive_refresh_v1|seed|source_video_id; random.Random.sample(1..15,B-1)
protocol.oracle: exact enumerate all schedules including 0; minimize all-16-output mean cosine error; lexicographically earliest within 1e-12 of minimum
protocol.oracle_scope: offline diagnostic bound; unavailable to scored callbacks
protocol.metric: post-decision appearance-feature error, mean over all 16 outputs; pre-decision drift logged separately by evaluator
protocol.aggregation: random first averages all ten seeds within each video; then every video equal weight
protocol.comparison: error(periodic)-error(policy); percentages per video before aggregation; negative values preserved; percentage undefined if reference error<=1e-12
protocol.example_selection: B=4 age-plus-motion largest absolute gain and largest loss versus periodic; video-ID tie break; descriptive only
limits: validation thresholds selected on evaluated validation videos
future-reference codec vectors and full-clip candidate selection: offline
